profile.name: Murat Gungor
profile.title: Full-Stack Developer
profile.bio: Full-stack developer with over four years of experience and a background in Health Psychology, bringing analytical problem-solving skills to building fast, scalable, and user-focused applications.

projects.title: Owlex
projects.description: Trading card scanner app (React Native) that identifies, prices, and lists cards to eBay across five games — powered by custom-trained on-device ML models achieving 91% top-1 and 99.1% top-5 recognition accuracy.
highlights: Trained a two-stage recognition system: YOLOX card detector + ArcFace embedding model with pgvector similarity search over a 100k+ card catalogue
Built the training data pipeline end-to-end — scraped real-world images from Reddit and eBay, auto-labelled with Grounding DINO, deduplicated by perceptual hash
Live eBay listing integration (OAuth + Inventory API), cache-first market pricing, and RevenueCat subscriptions
Beta tested with 15+ collectors and validated in person at an official TCG trading show

projects.title: GitDynamic
projects.description: Open-source dynamic boilerplate platform (formerly ShipShip) built with Next.js and Payload CMS, using conditional code blocks to generate tailored project scaffolds in minutes.
highlights: Pre-configured authentication, emailing, database setup, S3 storage, and blog functionality
Conditional code blocks produce dynamic boilerplates for each project configuration
Significantly reduces project setup time across supported tech stacks

projects.title: MaxReach

highlights: Web scraping and data enrichment at scale

Data hierarchy to prioritize specific data in the AI model

Applied classification models to support early diagnosis in healthcare

about.story: My journey combines psychology and technology in unique ways. With a Master's in Health Psychology and a First Class Honours in Psychology, I bring analytical problem-solving skills to software development. I transitioned into tech because I saw the potential to build tools that genuinely help people—from AI-driven healthcare research to booking systems for small businesses.
about.approach: I believe in building fast, scalable applications that prioritize user experience. My psychology background helps me understand user needs at a deeper level, while my technical skills allow me to implement efficient solutions. I'm always learning—whether it's migrating to new frameworks like Qwik, building open-source tools like GitDynamic, or training my own ML models for Owlex, my card scanner app.
